messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT 1718452345: inference-prod error-rate spike detected (>5% 5m) in us-west-2. PagerDuty: oncall@sre. start=2024-06-15T14:12:25Z

sara: Jumping in — seeing ~6.2% errors across the embedding endpoints. Spike aligned with the 14:09 model rollout.

mike: I can confirm. Lots of 504s from model-backend. Spike concentrated to model variant v2-q4, tail latency up on a subset of GPU hosts.

kevin: Looking at runtime metrics — KV cache miss ratio jumped and batching latency spiked. Suspect a change to the batching window in the recent deploy.

sara: Ok. Immediate mitigation: rolling traffic off v2-q4. I'll also snooze PD for 30m to cut the paging cascade while we work.

julia: +1 on snooze. Do we have customer impact yet? Which tenants hit errors?

mike: Only three production tenants so far showing elevated errors (ids redacted). Errors are request-level 504/timeout, no data corruption.

kevin: Routing change ready. I can pin traffic: route v2-q4 -> v2-q2 fallback for 1 hour. CLI: `rio route create --from v2-q4 --to v2-q2 --dur 3600`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: route applied by kevin at 2024-06-15T14:19:02Z — observing metrics.

mike: After the reroute errors dropped to ~0.8% within 3m. Good signal.

mike: Did a quick PD tweak: changed dedupe/window for the inference error alert to 2m and grouped alerts by cluster+model so we don't flood ops with dupes. Also set a temporary rate_limit on the PD policy.

sara: Paste the PD rule snippet so we capture it in the postmortem.

mike: PD rule excerpt: `condition: rate(errors, 1m) > 5% for 2m; grouping_keys: [cluster, model, severity]; dedupe_window: 120s; rate_limit: 1/min`

kevin: Added a dashboard tile: "inference errors by model variant" and a panic alert for tail latency >800ms on any host.

julia: I'll own customer comms. Can someone list affected tenants + window we saw failures and the rollback time? I'll coordinate with support.

sara: Affected tenants: 3 (CRM-cohort A, analytics-sandbox, partner-X). Failure window ~14:09–14:19 UTC. Reroute applied 14:19, errors back to baseline by 14:22. I'll capture in incident doc.

sara: Post-incident action items (short):
- PR #489: revert batching config (owner: mike)
- Add automated canary gating for model variant rollouts (owner: kevin)
- Promote PD dedupe to 5m for this alert class after review (owner: mike)
- Add cache-miss ratio alert/metric to runtime dashboard (owner: kevin)
- Customer note (owner: julia)

mike: I'll take PR 489 and the PD rule change.

kevin: I'll investigate KV cache heuristics, instrument miss ratio, and propose a conservative batching window.

julia: I'll draft a short status for affected customers and post to the incident doc + support channel.

sara: Un-snoozing PD in 25m unless we see recurrence. Leaving this thread for postmortem edits. :thumbsup:

kevin: Quick note — let's add grouping by model_variant_id to the PD grouping keys permanently. That reduces noise when a single variant misbehaves.

mike: Agreed. We'll include that in the follow-up change.

julia: Thanks all, good mitigation. I'll file the follow-up tickets and ping owners.

sara: closing bridge for now, keeping channel open for postmortem additions.
